arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} | shape={df.shape} ===")
    print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "budget.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb["Budget"]

print("A23 (Total Expenses label):", repr(ws["A23"].value))
print("B23 (current value):", repr(ws["B23"].value))

for r in range(11, 23):
    print(r, repr(ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value),
          repr(ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value),
          repr(ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value))

if not ws["B23"].value:
    ws["B23"] = "=SUM(B11:B22)"
    wb.save(path)
    print("Wrote =SUM(B11:B22) to B23")
else:
    print("B23 already populated; no change")

import os
import pandas as pd

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("Files:", os.listdir("."))

fname = "budget.xlsx"
print("Exists:", os.path.exists(fname))

if os.path.exists(fname):
    xl = pd.ExcelFile(fname)
    print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
    for sh in xl.sheet_names:
        df = pd.read_excel(fname, sheet_name=sh, header=None)
        print(f"--- Sheet: {sh} | shape={df.shape}")
        print(df.head(20).to_string(max_colwidth=40))

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name="Budget", header=None)
print(df.to_string(max_colwidth=40))

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name="Budget", header=None)

# Expense rows: EXPENSES header at row idx 9, Total Expenses label at row idx 22
exp = df.iloc[10:22].copy()  # Excel rows 11-22 (category, sub-item, amount)
exp.columns = ["category", "item", "amount"]
exp["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(exp["amount"], errors="coerce")
exp = exp.dropna(subset=["amount"])

by_cat = exp.groupby("category")["amount"].sum()
total = float(exp["amount"].sum())

print("Per-category expenses:")
for cat, amt in by_cat.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {amt:,.2f}")
print(f"TOTAL EXPENSES (all categories): {total:,.2f}")
print(f"Line items counted: {len(exp)}")
